purpose: Isolate bounded residual and fixed initial sparse support on two previously failed TRAIN endpoints
residual_initialization: all zeros, independent reset for every case
bounded_equation: F0 + a*tanh(R/a), a=3*std; equals original F0+a*tanh(U), U=R/a
parameter_units: feature units; equal initial Jacobian on nonzero-std channels
support: complete initial coordinates, no motion support expansion or truncation
native_codec: original baseline, all parameters and buffers frozen, eval, native hard pruning
loss: real-view full MAE + hand ROI MAE + (10/9)*motion weighted MAE; no auxiliary, teacher, or temporal term
secondary_view: evaluation against existing native-GS teacher only; no training supervision
checkpoint_selection: fixed final step 600, no best-frame selection
failure_policy: stop failing worker, preserve error and all records; no retries, truncation, or automatic architecture changes
engineering_acceptance: both 600-step modes at both endpoints; real nonzero feature gradient; all codec tensors unchanged; independent final native replay passes
scientific_acceptance: visual confirmation of yellow-bar vertical pose at frame44 and crossbar spanning pillars at frame132; RGB and fixed color proxies are supporting diagnostics only
limitations: two hand-selected known failures, single TRAIN clip, free per-endpoint features, no action code or posterior encoder, no temporal consistency or AR/generalization claim; failure does not prove nonexistence of a solution
